main_body: three-story brick campus building with flat concrete roof
top_band: light grey tiled flat roof with parapet and rooftop vents, rows 1-40
evidence: Rows 1-40 show the foreshortened flat roof from above, enclosed by a light grey parapet (front parapet at rows 38-40) with cast shadow inside at rows 3-6 and rooftop vents showing their tops and south faces. Below row 40 is the cream cornice (rows 41-49) with eave shadow at row 41 and row 46, followed by the 3-story brick front facade (rows 50-143) with recessed windows and arched double doors.

style.evidence: The building features rich brick masonry with multi-tone individual bricks and mortar lines, speckled concrete roof slabs, detailed cornice dentils, and multi-stepped window panes and door panels. Outlines use dark material tones (dark maroon/brown on brick, dark grey-blue on roof).
